docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
La Vallée Poussin’s six lectures on the Buddhist way of salvation: the monastic discipline, the doctrines of the self and of karma, and the path to nirvāṇa (1917). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The way to Nirvana; six lectures on ancient Buddhism as a discipline of salvation · La Vallée Poussin, Louis de, 1869-1938 · 1917, 185 scanned pages. Published 1917; Louis de La Vallée Poussin died 1938; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
